block.note: Week 2, 3 gym mornings before Jacksonville. Mon is a heavy Chest + Shoulders day with a tight abs circuit. Tue is now Back + Abs so chest gets a rest day. Wed is unchanged. Heavy sets rest 75s; accessories and abs rest 30s. No lunges.

warmUp: Use the app's Quick Warm-Up card (bodyweight squats, glute bridges, arm circles or light face pulls, bird dogs).
finisher: Optional 5 min easy StairMaster. Skip if you're short on time.

days.name: Mon 11/23 – Gym A: Heavy Chest + Shoulders + Abs

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Heavy day. Two lighter warm-up sets first. Stop 1-2 reps short of failure; drop to 45 if the bar path or elbows get sloppy.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.note: New. Bench upright, press overhead without arching your lower back. 30 lb each hand to start; go up if the last rep is clean.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.note: New. Bench at about 30 degrees for upper chest. 35 lb each hand to start.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.note: New. Low pulley, raise out to shoulder height, lead with the elbow. Keep it light and strict.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.note: New. Handles at shoulder height, soft elbows, squeeze the handles together in front of your chest.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch or Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.note: Abs circuit: go straight into the next ab move, rest 30s after each round.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.note: New. Lower back pressed into the floor the whole time; slow reach of opposite arm and leg.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.note: Rotate from your core, not your arms.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up (Gravitron)
exercises.note: New. Use the Gravitron instead of the pulldown. Start with plenty of assist so you get 8-10 smooth reps, no swinging. Less assist on the next set if it felt easy.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.note: New. Chest on an incline bench, row the DBs, squeeze your shoulder blades, don't shrug. Start at 30 lb each hand.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.note: New. Sit tall, pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades. 70 lb to start; adjust so the last 2 reps are hard.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
exercises.note: New. Rope or bar from the high pulley, arms nearly straight, sweep down to your thighs using your lats.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.note: New. Stand sideways to a mid-height cable, press the handle straight out and pause, resist the twist. 20 lb is plenty to start.

days.name: Wed 11/25 – Gym C: Glutes + Hams + Abs

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (DB on hips)
exercises.note: New. Upper back on the floor or bench, DB on the working-side hip, other foot off the floor, drive through the heel and squeeze at the top. 30 lb is a conservative start.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine
exercises.goal: Was 40-60x12-14; stay at 60 and push 14-15 clean reps

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.goal: Was 20x12; try 25x12. Rotate from your core, not your arms.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.goal: Hold the 90s you already logged; use auto 2nd side if you do both

exercises.name: Cable Crunch or Hanging Knee Raise
